note: The single source of player-facing text for field_game.
No component may write a player-facing string inline; every one is read
from here through the copy accessor described in field_game/AGENTS.md.
Wording rules, including readable limits on objectives and instructions,
are encoded in tools/lexicon-data.json and are enforced by

notice.content_invalid.text: The field could not be established.

notice.echo_route_removal.text: Cutting that route changed the pattern.

notice.echo_boundary_severance.text: Severing the boundary changed the pattern.

notice.echo_component_substitution.text: Replacing that node changed the pattern.

notice.echo_evaluation.text: The committed Route edit changed the pattern.

instruction.move_view.text: Move the View. Physics stays unchanged.

regime.open_field.supply.text: Authored finite streams; deterministic addressed delivery

ability.lens.text: Paid 30-step chassis-local forecast; no remote or hidden state

ability.knot.text: Deploys persistent routing junctions from finite carried material

lab.local_rules_only.text: Local rules and sensed signals only

lab.observe_disclosure.text: Changing this protocol is free and cannot alter Field physics.

lab.divergence_description.text: Replay one Anchor twice with one changed condition and the same addressed random draws.

lab.first_divergence_disclosure.text: The first recorded divergence is not labeled the complete cause.

lab.no_replay.text: No paired replay has been run for this scenario.

lab.ensemble_description.text: Hold specification, regime, inputs, control mode, and macroscopic initial condition fixed while addressed runtime seeds vary.

lab.no_ensemble.text: No Ensemble has been compiled for this scenario.

lab.range_disclosure.text: The minimum-to-maximum band is an observed range, not a confidence interval.

lab.trace_preview_disclosure.text: This preview replays recorded throughput evidence only; the sealed schedule remains undisclosed.

lab.holdout_ready.text: The schedule is sealed. Direct control and physical edits are disabled.

lab.holdout_unsealed.text: Seal the ScenarioSpec before the hidden schedule is revealed.

pressure.rule.drain.text: Target-layer Drain becomes base Drain × (1 + level).

pressure.rule.noise.text: Target-layer Route transfer is multiplied by 1 - effective Noise × addressed draw.

pressure.rule.fracture.text: On Crisis entry, cut the targeted Route or the highest trailing-flow Route once.

pressure.rule.flood.text: Target overload threshold becomes capacity × (1 - 0.5 × level).

pressure.rule.interference.text: Redirect 0.5 × level of each same-layer Supply emission to the target Component first.

pressure.rule.drift.text: On each stage entry, translate target-layer Supply paths by 256 × level units on the addressed axis.

lab.archive_description.text: Export the authoritative run together with the scenario fingerprint and the evidence contract used by these benches.

lab.renewal_description.text: Degrade one Component and require local detection, material recruitment, positioning, reconnection, and functional recovery without player rescue.

lab.no_renewal.text: No local Renewal trial has been run for this scenario.

lab.renewal_disclosure.text: Rust chooses the failed Component from authoritative state and searches only the bounded local Field for typed material, a charged donor, local deficit signals, and existing attachment topology. The shell supplies only a trial seed; the embodied inventory remains visible before launch.

intervention.blade.disclosure.text: A live Blade stages one paid Route cut in the Still Mode queue.

intervention.clamp.disclosure.text: A live Clamp stages one paid Route ceiling; exact capacity returns after the declared duration.

intervention.scramble.disclosure.text: Total Charge remains conserved while destinations vary.

intervention.decoy.disclosure.text: Captured Supply is transferred to the selected receiving Node.

intervention.delay.disclosure.text: The addressed input moves later without changing its magnitude.

intervention.replace.disclosure.text: Transferred properties remain explicitly recorded as external support.

intervention.breach.disclosure.text: A live Breach stages one paid increase to the current material boundary; the exact coefficient returns after the declared duration.

intervention.transplant.disclosure.text: Retained state and equilibration interval remain part of the plan.

label.handoff.text: Hand control to the next Form

promise.ring.text: Holds up to 1,536 CU; 384-field-unit Route reach.

promise.relay.text: Moves charge across long routes, vulnerable to cuts.

promise.lens.text: Forecasts distant change, holds little charge.

promise.knot.text: Supports dense routing, pays high upkeep.

promise.wake.text: Leaves delayed effects along its path.

promise.chorus.text: Coordinates several linked Forms, vulnerable to separation.

explanation.pressure_drain.text: Drain steadily removes stored Charge, deepening what each layer already takes. It builds from a signal through pressure to a crisis, then resolves and passes. Deeper layers drain harder, so retreating upward slows the loss while it stands.

explanation.pressure_noise.text: Noise distorts routes and forecasts, so what the Field reports drifts from what it does. It builds from a signal through pressure to a crisis, then resolves and passes. Readings taken during it deserve less trust than usual.

explanation.pressure_fracture.text: Fracture breaks existing connections. It builds from a signal through pressure to a crisis, then resolves and passes. Routes with an alternative path around them lose less when one is cut.

explanation.pressure_flood.text: Flood overloads heavily used Nodes, pressing them past their thresholds. It builds from a signal through pressure to a crisis, then resolves and passes. A Node standing over its threshold sheds Charge and throttles its Routes, so spreading the load suppresses what Flood accelerates.

explanation.pressure_interference.text: Interference redirects currents through competing paths. It builds from a signal through pressure to a crisis, then resolves and passes. A Pulse released within reach of its target presses it back a quarter at a time.

explanation.pressure_drift.text: Drift moves valuable regions across the field. It builds from a signal through pressure to a crisis, then resolves and passes. A pattern anchored to one place weathers it worse than one that can follow.

explanation.still_mode.text: Still Mode pauses the Field. View selection is immediate and free; each committed Route or physical-compartment edit spends one Intervention.

explanation.impulse.text: The Intervention Budget pays for queued physical edits. You hold up to six Interventions and regain three after completing a layer objective.

explanation.handoff.text: Control moves to another Form at once, and costs no Intervention. Only one Form is steered at a time: the one you leave keeps its station in a linked set, or slows to a stop where it stands. Every Form gathers from the band it stands in whether or not you steer it, so which one you hold decides where a Pulse can reach and which pattern you can tend.

explanation.coordinate_profile.text: The coordinate profile is ten separate readings of the standing View over its window. They are never added, averaged, or folded into one figure, and none of them ranks anything: ranking reads the four privilege values alone. Eight are read off the recorded window. The last two replay it, so they are taken only when you ask for them. A reading the window cannot support carries no number and says why.

explanation.chapter_review.text: A chapter closes when every objective it requires is complete. An Anchor is written at that step, so the run can be resumed exactly here. The next chapter establishes its own Field, currents, and pressures; what you carry across is the Form you chose, the Interventions you hold, and the objectives already behind you.

explanation.ending.text: The last chapter of the campaign is complete. The run stands where it ended and takes no further step; a new run may be started, or an exported run imported, from here.

explanation.the_edge.hold_the_current.text: The bright Supply Stream delivers Charge each step to all three Nodes in its band. The physical compartment is a separate object: it initially contains only the central Reserve and Module. Keep the Form in the band and compare what the stream supplies with what those two members retain.

ending.the_pull.text: The current is followed and held. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_edge.text: The inside stands. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_loop.text: The circuit closes on itself. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_echo.text: The earlier trace answered the later break. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_mesh.text: Two patterns stand, and neither is the other. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_break.text: The pattern carried on past the break. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_rewrite.text: The module is replaced and continuity holds. The campaign closes here.

ending.the_quiet_edge.text: The pattern continues without direct control.

objective.the_pull.follow_current.text: Steer into the bright cyan Supply Stream.

explanation.the_pull.follow_current.text: The cyan band is a Supply Stream. It delivers stored Q to Components inside its capture boundary; it does not push the Form. Steer into the band and watch its filaments connect to the Form.

objective.the_pull.hold_center.text: Remain in Supply until the Form stores 256 CU.

explanation.the_pull.hold_center.text: Remain connected until the reservoir around the Form reaches 256 CU. Moving outside the Supply Stream breaks the delivery filaments and stops the inflow.

objective.the_pull.release_pulse.text: Steer toward the hollow segmented Port.

explanation.the_pull.release_pulse.text: The hollow circular Component is a dormant Port. Move close enough that the Form can reach it with Coupling; no action is required until the Port enters the visible coupling range.

objective.the_pull.open_port.text: Hold E until the Port locks, then release E.

explanation.the_pull.open_port.text: Hold E to extend Coupling. The true reach expands around the Form and the dormant Port locks when reached. Release E to open it. Coupling spends no stored Q; it is recorded external control.

objective.the_pull.close_loop.text: Open all three Ports until every loop Route flows.

explanation.the_pull.close_loop.text: Three Routes stand between three Ports, tail to head and back again. Open all three Ports and the Charge runs the circuit: Routes are passed in ascending order each step, so a closed circuit carries several hops in one step and sustains itself.

objective.the_pull.carry_pattern.text: Keep every loop Route flowing continuously.

explanation.the_pull.carry_pattern.text: Every Route in the loop must carry on the same step. An overloaded Component with active outgoing flow is transport in flight; without active relief it becomes a recoverable setback. Open the relief Port if the loop stops carrying.

objective.the_pull.take_the_depth.text: Use ] to descend into the deeper blue Supply Stream.

explanation.the_pull.take_the_depth.text: The field stands in layers, and the Form may take one. The wheel over the surface, or the two bracket keys, moves it a layer at a time, and one change waits a moment before the next is read. The deeper layer gives twice what this one gives and takes a steady loss from every Node standing on it, so depth is a trade rather than a direction.

objective.the_pull.open_the_deep_port.text: Optional: open the deep hollow Port with E.

explanation.the_pull.open_the_deep_port.text: This one is optional. It stands for a while and then the chapter carries on without it, so taking it costs nothing and letting it go costs nothing but the time it stood. A Pulse reaches only what stands on the Form's own layer, so the Port past the deep current's far end is opened from beside it, and reaching it asks for a long hold.

objective.the_pull.hold_the_moving_curre.text: Follow the displaced bright Supply Stream until the progress bar completes.

explanation.the_pull.hold_the_moving_cur.text: Drift moves this current across the field, once at each stage it enters, and each move is wider than the one before it until the pressure passes. The count is cumulative: a step outside the band adds nothing and takes nothing away, so what is asked is that you follow the band to where it went and stand in it again.

explanation.the_edge.set_it_running.text: Three Routes carry from the reserve the bright current fills, through two Nodes, and out to the Node west of them, which pays away everything that reaches it. Each Route is wider than the one before it, so nothing along the line can be given more than it can pass on. The two Nodes that stand closed open a moment after the chapter does, and the line carries from the step they do: a Route moves Charge only while the Nodes at both of its ends stand open.

explanation.the_edge.open_the_stores.text: Two more Ports stand outside the line, one north and one east, each in the outer current and each holding everything it has been given. Open them and their Routes carry inward — a second way in and a third, for the stretches when the bright current does not run.

explanation.the_edge.hold_the_inside.text: The thick material edge encloses the Reserve and Module. Each enclosed Node loses 1/1024 of its held Charge per exposed outside contact on every simulation step; Route flow and Supply can replace that loss. The thin violet View may inspect any Nodes, but moving it changes none of these quantities.

explanation.the_edge.draw_the_edge.text: Space opens Still Mode. Drag a handle on the thick material edge across a Node to propose new physical membership; Enter commits the edit for one Intervention and ends the retained causal trace. The thin violet View is a free measurement selection: moving, replacing, or clearing it cannot change Charge, leakage, Routes, the plan queue, or the Intervention Budget.

objective.the_edge.take_the_depth.text: Take the Form a layer down.

explanation.the_edge.take_the_depth.text: The wheel over the surface, or the two bracket keys, moves the Form a layer at a time, and one change waits a moment before the next is read. The deeper layer pays twice what this one pays and takes a steady loss from every Node standing on it, so depth is a trade rather than a direction.

objective.the_edge.open_the_deep_store.text: Open that store, if you like.

explanation.the_edge.open_the_deep_store.text: This one is optional. It stands for a while and then the chapter carries on without it, so taking it costs nothing and letting it go costs nothing but the time it stood. The Port under the deep current has taken Charge from that current since the chapter opened and released none of it. A Pulse reaches only what stands on the Form's own layer, so it is opened from beside it, and what it holds runs to the inside once it is.

objective.the_edge.hold_the_edge.text: Hold the compartment through three stops.

explanation.the_edge.hold_the_edge.text: The bright Supply Stream stops three times: for 50, 80, and 110 seconds at the 30-step-per-second simulation rate. Surface drain rises during each stop. The physical compartment carries only what its members have stored and what open Routes deliver; reshape the thick edge, open the outer Ports, or form a Route in Still Mode. Moving the View cannot rescue the system.

explanation.the_loop.follow_the_supply.text: The bright band is this chapter's only supply. It gives Charge each step to the Nodes standing in it, and the Form's own Node is one of them. No other Node on this field is given anything, so what the circuit runs on is what the Form carries out of this band.

explanation.the_loop.open_the_intake.text: A Port stands closed until a Pulse reaches it, and a Route carries nothing while either of its ends is closed. The intake is where the run begins: open it, and the Routes drawn beyond it have somewhere to start from.

objective.the_loop.open_the_run.text: Open the rest of the run.

explanation.the_loop.open_the_run.text: Three more Ports stand along the run, and the Routes between them are drawn already. Each opens the way the first one did: hold E beside it and release. A longer hold reaches farther, and Coupling opens every dormant Port visibly locked inside its reach.

explanation.the_loop.start_the_run.text: Charge reaches the run only along a Route you draw. Still Mode holds the field still: a handle on the Form and a handle on the intake propose one connection, and Enter commits it for one Intervention. The Form must stand inside its own reach of the Port, so bring it near before you ask.

explanation.the_loop.hold_the_run.text: The last Node of the run has nowhere to send what arrives, so it fills, carries more than it can hold, and sheds a quarter of the excess every step while it does. Give it somewhere to go: open one of the stores below the run and connect the outfall to it. Each store returns Charge to the intake at its own rate, and the circuit closes on itself.

objective.the_loop.open_the_spare.text: Open the spare, if you like.

explanation.the_loop.open_the_spare.text: This one is optional. The spare junction is a fourth store, and the widest of the four: it banks more than any of the others and returns Charge to the intake slowly. Nothing runs through it until a Route is drawn to it. It stands for a while and then the chapter carries on without it.

explanation.the_loop.carry_the_circuit.text: Every Node of the run pays upkeep out of what it holds, every step, and the store pays too. The circuit carries Charge back to the intake but makes none, so the band is what keeps it standing. The count starts again from nothing on any step the run is not carrying, and leaving the band for long is what stops it.

objective.the_loop.carry_the_break.text: Carry the run past the closure.

explanation.the_loop.carry_the_break.text: One Port of the run closes as this objective opens, and every Route through it stops. No routing carries the run past a closed Port: a Pulse released beside it is the one thing that opens it again. Nothing is lost while the run stands still except the time it stands.

explanation.the_loop.close_and_sustain.text: Flood finds the Node the most Charge has passed through and holds it, and it looks again at every stage it enters. While it stands, that Node carries more than it can hold at a lower level than its own, so it sheds a quarter of the excess every step. What the stores have banked is what pays for that loss, and the run stands as long as more arrives than leaves.

explanation.the_echo.hold_the_light.text: A current delivers Charge each step to every Node standing in its band, and the Form's own Node is one of them. A Route runs from that Node to the store beyond the band's east end, so what is gathered here arrives there. Nothing else on this layer stands in the band.

explanation.the_echo.open_the_ring.text: A Port stands closed until a Pulse reaches it. Two of them stand between the store and the Route that returns to it, and a Route carries Charge only while both of its Nodes are open.

explanation.the_echo.run_the_ring.text: Routes are passed in ascending order each step, so Charge leaves the store, crosses both Ports and comes back to the store inside one step. What the ring turns on is what the store holds.

explanation.the_echo.hold_the_ring.text: The near Node takes more each step than it passes on, so it climbs past its threshold, sheds a quarter of the excess every step, and halves the Routes into it while it stands there. Open the Port beside it and the Charge has somewhere else to go.

explanation.the_echo.take_the_deep_band.text: The wheel over the surface, or the two bracket keys, moves the Form a layer at a time, and one change waits a moment before the next is read. The deeper layer gives twice what this one gives and takes a steady loss from every Node standing on it.

objective.the_echo.lay_the_spare_line.text: Open that Port, if you like.

explanation.the_echo.lay_the_spare_line.text: This one is optional. It stands for a while and then the chapter carries on without it, so taking it costs nothing and letting it go costs nothing but the time it stood. The Port it names is the one Route between the deep store and the ring, and a Pulse reaches only what stands on the Form's own layer.

explanation.the_echo.fill_before_the_ech.text: The store holds two thousand and forty-eight units before it begins to shed, and the ring spends what it holds. Standing in the bright current is how Charge goes back into it from this layer.

explanation.the_echo.hold_through_the_ec.text: The ring turns on what the store holds, and what the store holds is what was gathered before now. Whatever else was already running into the ring when the bright current stopped is running into it still.

explanation.the_mesh.follow_the_supply.text: The bright current delivers Charge every step to every Node standing in its band, and the intake standing in it is what supplies the whole of this chapter. Stand in it and watch the intake fill.

explanation.the_mesh.open_the_north_stor.text: Three Forms stand on this field and only one of them is steered. The northern store is a Port, and a Pulse released beside it is what opens it — the Form already standing beside it is a press away, in Still Mode, under Hand control to the next Form. Control moves at once and costs no Intervention.

explanation.the_mesh.open_the_south_stor.text: The same again, on the other side. The southern Form stands beside the southern store, and the whole of what a Handoff asks is that you take it up. The Form you leave slows to a stop where it stands and keeps whatever its Node holds.

explanation.the_mesh.carry_the_first_pat.text: A pattern stands when every Route of it carries Charge on the same step and no Node of it is carrying more than it can hold. The northern pattern runs intake, collector, store, outfall, and back to the intake. Keep the intake supplied and it turns on its own.

explanation.the_mesh.open_the_spare_inta.text: A second Node stands in the band, further east, and it is closed. Opening it is what makes a second supply possible: the southern pattern can draw from the main intake or from this one, and that choice is the chapter's own.

explanation.the_mesh.link_the_second_pat.text: The southern pattern has a collector, a store, and a return, and no way in. In Still Mode, draw one Route into its collector — from the main intake, or from the spare one. Both leave the pattern flowing. What they do not share is what happens when Interference arrives.

explanation.the_mesh.take_the_depth.text: The deeper current pays double what the surface pays and takes a steady loss for standing there. The wheel or the bracket keys take the Form down a layer and back up. Nothing above stops while you are down here.

explanation.the_mesh.open_the_deep_port.text: This one is optional. It stands for a while and then the chapter carries on without it. A Pulse cannot cross a layer, so it can only be opened from down here — and nothing later asks for it.

explanation.the_mesh.hold_both_patterns.text: Both patterns stand or neither counts: every Route of both carries Charge on the same step, and neither the intake nor the outfall carries more than it can hold. Interference gives one Node first claim on everything the band delivers, which makes leaning on that one Node look like enough. It is not: what one intake can pass on bounds what both patterns can draw.

explanation.the_break.follow_the_supply.text: The bright current delivers Charge each step, split between every Node standing in its band. The intake stands in it, so what the band gives is what the run will have. Keep the Form inside the band and this objective completes.

objective.the_break.open_the_intake.text: Open the intake in the band.

explanation.the_break.open_the_intake.text: A Port stands closed until Coupling reaches it, and a Route carries nothing while either of its ends is closed. The intake stands in the band beside the Form: hold E until its segmented gate locks, then release E.

explanation.the_break.open_the_lines.text: Two lines stand below the intake, and each is a way into the run. Open both. Which of them the run carries through is settled later, by the Route you draw, and not by which Port is open.

explanation.the_break.open_the_run.text: Below the lines stand the junction, the core, and the outfall the core sends to. One long Pulse released between them opens all three at once. Nothing carries Charge through any of them yet.

explanation.the_break.start_the_run.text: Charge reaches the run only along a Route you draw. Still Mode holds the field still: a handle on the intake and a handle on a line propose one connection, and Enter commits it for one Intervention. The two Nodes must stand inside the Form's own reach of each other.

objective.the_break.hold_the_run.text: Hold the run through the cut.

explanation.the_break.hold_the_run.text: The run carries what the band gives to the core, and the core sends what it can to the outfall. A dim current stands over the core from here on, and carries a little into it on its own. Part way through this hold the junction's own Route into the core is severed: the junction then carries more than it can hold, and the objective stands in a setback until you move one end of a line onto the core yourself, in Still Mode.

objective.the_break.open_the_store.text: Open the store, if you like.

explanation.the_break.open_the_store.text: This one is optional. The store stands away from the run and takes Charge from the intake along a slow Route, but only once it is open, so a store opened here is a full store later. Nothing later requires it, and letting it go costs the time it stood.

explanation.the_break.carry_the_run.text: Nothing new is asked. The run has to keep carrying while the store fills, and the count starts again from nothing on any step the core sends the outfall nothing.

objective.the_break.hold_past_the_break.text: Hold the run past the break.

explanation.the_break.hold_past_the_brea.text: Fracture finds the standing Route the most Charge has lately passed through and breaks it, once, when it reaches its crisis. That is the Route you drew, and it does not come back. Three answers stand: move one end of a line onto the intake, connect the store into the core, or cut the Route into the tail and reshape the inside to the core and its outfall, which the dim current alone can carry.

explanation.the_rewrite.follow_the_band.text: The bright band delivers sixteen units of Charge a step, split between every Node standing in it, and the Form is a Node. A Route already runs from the Form to the intake, so what the Form gathers reaches the run: the intake fills, the two carriers between it and the junction pass eight a step along, and the junction banks what the run has not spent. Step out of the band and nothing new arrives: the run has what it has, every Node of it pays its own upkeep, and the boundary leaks a share of what the inside holds every step.

explanation.the_rewrite.open_the_depende.text: Two Nodes stand east of the junction with a Route already drawn to each of them. A Route into a Node that is not open carries nothing, so nothing reaches them yet. A Pulse released beside a Node opens it, and the reach grows with how long the Pulse is held: an empty release reaches eight units and a full charge reaches a hundred and ninety-two.

explanation.the_rewrite.run_the_dependen.text: Once both are open the junction sends what it holds along both Routes, three units a step each. That pair is the dependency: everything east of the junction runs on what those two Routes carry, and they carry only on a step the junction has something to send.

explanation.the_rewrite.hold_the_depende.text: Both Routes have to carry on the same step, and neither Node beyond them may hold more than its own threshold. Nothing takes Charge out of those two yet, so they fill in a dozen steps, carry more than they can hold, and shed a quarter of the excess every step while they do. Still Mode is where that is answered: draw a Route from each of them to the store beyond, and what arrives has somewhere to go. Each queued change costs one Intervention, and a completed objective gives three back.

explanation.the_rewrite.take_the_deep_ba.text: The deep band delivers twenty a step where the bright one delivers sixteen, because the deeper layer pays at twice the rate of the surface. It also takes one unit a step from every Node standing on it. The Route from the Form to the intake carries across layers, so the run keeps its supply while the Form is down there.

objective.the_rewrite.open_the_deep_spar.text: Open the spare, if you like.

explanation.the_rewrite.open_the_deep_sp.text: This one is optional. A Port stands two hundred and twenty units below the deep band, further than the longest Pulse reaches, so the Form has to leave the band to open it. No Route runs to it and nothing later in the chapter asks for it: what it costs is the time spent away from the band. It stands for its own span and then the chapter carries on without it, which takes longer than taking it does.

explanation.the_rewrite.carry_the_supply.text: Fracture builds through two stages and breaks one Route as it enters the third, and the one it is aimed at here is the line from the Form to the intake. Nothing routes around a Route that is gone. The intake holds a few hundred units and the junction rather more, so the dependency stands about a hundred steps on what is already banked. Drawing the line again is one queued change. A Route reaches only between two Nodes inside the Form's own reach, and this one runs from the Form's own Node, with 512 units added to every distance for each layer between them: it cannot be drawn from the deep band at all.

explanation.the_rewrite.rewrite_the_modu.text: The two carriers between the intake and the junction are the module, and the Route joining them breaks two minutes into this objective. From the step this objective opens, every Node on the surface loses a tenth of a unit each step as well, so nothing here holds what it held. Once the Route between the carriers is gone the junction takes nothing in at all — no Route reaches it from the intake, wherever the Form is standing — and it spends six a step, so the dependency stands about seventy steps on what it banked. What a late rewrite pays for is the waiting and nothing else. Both spares below the carriers are open and empty, the standby beside the junction is full, and one queue holds six changes: a Route drawn, one end of a Route moved, a Route cut, the physical compartment reshaped. What the run carries out of this chapter is the Interventions it closes with: what it had, less what the changes cost, plus the three the last completion grants, clamped at six.

explanation.the_quiet_edge.close_the_spa.text: The pattern is an intake, five arms, and a hold that carries back round to the intake. Every arm needs a Route out of it or it takes in more than it can hold. A sixth arm stands beside the five with its own way out already drawn and nothing carrying into it. Six Routes drawn is six queued changes, and only a run carrying six Interventions can afford them before anything here completes.

explanation.the_quiet_edge.close_the_rin.text: Five Routes, one out of each arm into the hold, close the pattern; each is one queued change. A run carrying five Interventions can draw all five and hold the pattern before this stands down. A run carrying four cannot, and its way through is the relief Port on the layer below, which no queued change is spent on and which costs the time it takes to get there.

Every arm needs somewhere to send what arrives, or it stands over its own threshold and sheds a quarter of the excess each step. Draw a Route from each arm into the hold, or open the relief Port at depth with a Pulse so the last arm carries through it instead. The pattern is held when all five arms carry and none of them is over.

explanation.the_quiet_edge.take_the_deep.text: The deeper current delivers twice what the bright one does per step, and it stands over the relief Port. Press for depth and hold the band. The ring carries the pattern the whole time the Form is down there, which is what closing it bought.

explanation.the_quiet_edge.hold_past_the.text: The deep current stops as this opens. What reaches the pattern from outside it is falling away, and the ring carries on what it already holds. Nothing here asks the Form to do anything the ring is not already doing.

explanation.the_quiet_edge.carry_the_clo.text: The bright band stops here as well, and the layer's loss is raised again. Nothing outside the pattern delivers anything now: what the ring carries is what the ring already held, less what the layer takes from every Node each step. The intake stands on about three thousand units when this opens.

explanation.the_quiet_edge.let_it_run.text: Nothing here needs the Form. Let go of the steering, release no Pulse, ask for no depth, open no Still Mode: the ring carries itself for the whole of this. Noise narrows what every Route on this layer moves while it runs, and the pattern is still standing at the end of it.

ending.the_quiet_edge.thread.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Thread crossed the field faster than any of the eight could.

ending.the_quiet_edge.thread.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Thread crossed the field faster than any of the eight could.

ending.the_quiet_edge.thread.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Thread crossed the field faster than any of the eight could.

ending.the_quiet_edge.ring.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Ring reached every arm from the shortest reach any Form has.

ending.the_quiet_edge.ring.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Ring reached every arm from the shortest reach any Form has.

ending.the_quiet_edge.ring.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Ring reached every arm from the shortest reach any Form has.

ending.the_quiet_edge.relay.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Relay drew each arm's line twice as wide as the others could.

ending.the_quiet_edge.relay.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Relay drew each arm's line twice as wide as the others could.

ending.the_quiet_edge.relay.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Relay drew each arm's line twice as wide as the others could.

ending.the_quiet_edge.vault.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Vault moved slowest of the eight and carried the largest store.

ending.the_quiet_edge.vault.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Vault moved slowest of the eight and carried the largest store.

ending.the_quiet_edge.vault.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Vault moved slowest of the eight and carried the largest store.

ending.the_quiet_edge.lens.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Lens carried the smallest store of the eight and read furthest ahead.

ending.the_quiet_edge.lens.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Lens carried the smallest store of the eight and read furthest ahead.

ending.the_quiet_edge.lens.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Lens carried the smallest store of the eight and read furthest ahead.

ending.the_quiet_edge.knot.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Knot paid more upkeep every step than any of the eight.

ending.the_quiet_edge.knot.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Knot paid more upkeep every step than any of the eight.

ending.the_quiet_edge.knot.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Knot paid more upkeep every step than any of the eight.

ending.the_quiet_edge.wake.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Wake left an entry behind it on every line it took, and the field kept them.

ending.the_quiet_edge.wake.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Wake left an entry behind it on every line it took, and the field kept them.

ending.the_quiet_edge.wake.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Wake left an entry behind it on every line it took, and the field kept them.

ending.the_quiet_edge.chorus.spare.text: The ring closed with its spare arm as well, and six arms carry it. Chorus held its linked Forms on station the whole way.

ending.the_quiet_edge.chorus.whole.text: The ring closed at once, and five arms carry it. Chorus held its linked Forms on station the whole way.

ending.the_quiet_edge.chorus.steady.text: The ring closed in its own time, and five arms carry it. Chorus held its linked Forms on station the whole way.

lab.open_field_description.text: Author one constrained scenario from implemented transport, supply, dissipation, observation, control, and criterion fields.

lab.open_field_disclosure.text: Rust validates the fixed-point lawset, assigns the SHA-256 identity, and seals every authored Component placement, Route, physical member, and Supply position as declared side information before hands-off cloned trials. Unsupported reactions and arbitrary equations are not offered.

lab.lens_disclosure.text: The projection uses only Nodes and Routes inside the 192-unit sensor radius, neutral future control, and a widening unresolved-state band. Remote state and hidden Holdout inputs are not shown.

automation.assembly.components_explanati.text: Placement is measured in Field units. Layer selects depth 0 through 7. Stored Charge is measured in CU and is limited to 4096 CU. Interface stance declares whether the Component begins able to admit an otherwise permitted transfer.

automation.assembly.currents_explanation.text: Active stance controls whether an authored Current begins operating. Phase is an integer step offset inside that Current's generator-defined period; preview refuses an offset outside the installed period.

automation.assembly.compartment_explanat.text: Membership declares which Components physically share the bounded compartment. Leakage is the fraction of stored Charge lost per exposed contact per step; an observation View never changes either value.

automation.assembly.warning.opening_stat.text: Transient runtime fields were normalized to their deterministic step-zero values.

automation.assembly.diff_prompt.text: Change one or more opening values, then preview. Rust will normalize the complete draft and list every changed address before commit is enabled.

automation.transition.sources.explanatio.text: Revert Generator can select only an immutable generator record attached to this attempt's exact ancestor chain. Branches, Blueprints, frozen requests, and complete results remain separate provenance readings even when they address identical generator bytes. Unavailable and corrupt sources stay visible but cannot be selected.

automation.transition.sources.read_error.text: Retained authority could not be read. No source is selectable; the current branch remains unchanged.

automation.transition.sources.empty.text: This branch has no resolvable ancestor generator source yet. Create a revision or restart boundary before attempting a reversion.

automation.transition.sources.reason.ava.text: The source resolves to exact V2 generator bytes with matching attempt, branch, contract, and content provenance.

automation.transition.sources.reason.mis.text: The parent branch identity is retained, but its immutable branch record is unavailable. Resolution stops at this boundary.

automation.transition.sources.reason.lin.text: The retained parent chain contains a cycle and cannot establish ancestry safely.

automation.transition.sources.reason.att.text: The retained parent branch claims a different attempt identity. It cannot enter this reversion boundary.

automation.transition.sources.reason.mis.text: The source names a generator hash or record, but the exact immutable generator record is unavailable.

automation.transition.sources.reason.imm.text: Two different immutable payloads claim the same identity. Neither payload can be selected.

automation.transition.sources.reason.uns.text: The source record is preserved for inspection, but its schema is not accepted by the current transition protocol.
The generator record is preserved for inspection, but Revert Generator requires current V2 source provenance.

automation.transition.sources.reason.gen.text: The resolved generator record does not contain the generator hash declared by this source.
The resolved generator bytes belong to a different attempt or branch provenance.

automation.transition.sources.reason.con.text: The source was authored under a different contract and cannot replace this contract's generator.
The source belongs to a different content version. It remains inspectable but cannot enter the current reconstruction.

automation.transition.sources.reason.req.text: The result's frozen qualification request is unavailable, so its branch provenance cannot be established.

automation.transition.sources.reason.res.text: The result group has no matching completeness marker and cannot serve as immutable source authority.

automation.transition.explanation.restar.text: Keep the current generator design and committed opening assembly exactly. Close this Commission branch, detach its live positions, stocks, timers, controller state, provisional criteria, and event window, then create a child branch reconstructed at the same declared opening.

automation.transition.explanation.revert.text: Replace the current generator design with the selected immutable retained generator. Rust reconstructs the current declared assembly only when every installed address remains compatible. The source record and all earlier evidence stay unchanged.

automation.transition.explanation.full_c.text: Replace both the current generator design and opening assembly with the versioned opening authored by this contract. The current branch closes as superseded, but its design records, Commission evidence, and qualification records remain retained engineering history.

automation.transition.status.previewing..text: Resolving the exact committed opening and calculating which Commission-only identities will detach...
Reading the selected immutable generator and compiling the current assembly against its exact addresses...
Resolving the contract-versioned authored generator, assembly, regime, and reconstruction boundary...

automation.transition.status.ready.resta.text: Restart preview accepted. The current Field is unchanged until Restart Assembly is confirmed.

automation.transition.status.ready.rever.text: Generator reversion preview accepted. Review every restored, retained, recreated, and detached identity before confirming.

automation.transition.status.ready.full_.text: Authored-opening preview accepted. Review the complete replacement boundary before confirming.

automation.transition.status.incompatibl.text: Compatibility compile complete. The selected generator and current opening remain inspectable below, but this exact combination cannot be committed.

automation.transition.status.commit_bloc.text: Commit is blocked because at least one addressed field or generator requirement would need adaptation, fabrication, or a generator edit. Cancel and revise the assembly or select another retained generator.

automation.transition.status.committing..text: Closing the current branch and reconstructing the same committed assembly as a new child...
Closing the current branch, restoring the selected generator bytes, and reconstructing the compatible assembly...
Closing the current branch and reconstructing the complete authored contract opening...

automation.transition.status.committed.r.text: Assembly restarted. The generator and declared opening are retained; the new child begins at reconstructed step-zero state.
Generator restored. The selected design now owns the child branch and the previous branch remains retained evidence.

automation.transition.status.committed.f.text: Authored opening restored. The contract's original generator and assembly now own the child branch; prior engineering history remains retained.

automation.transition.status.transport_r.text: The transition command did not reach an accepted Rust boundary. The current branch remains authoritative.

automation.transition.opening.explanatio.text: These are the complete assembly-owned values Rust will establish in the child branch. Expand each register to inspect every addressed Component, Form, material stock, Current, and physical-compartment reading before confirmation.

automation.transition.registers_boundary.text: Parent evidence detached; child state reconstructed

automation.transition.register.stored_ch.text: Live Component, reserve, and material stocks

automation.transition.register.controlle.text: Selected rules, targets, Route controls, and transient actuators

automation.transition.register.event_win.text: Retained Commission event and trace window

automation.transition.register.no_addres.text: No address-level entries are retained in this register.

automation.transition.compatibility_fiel.text: Current opening compiled against selected generator

Each row is one assembly-owned opening field. Retained-by-address fields require the selected generator to declare the same Component address and hardware kind; retained-unchanged fields do not depend on generator organization. Digests prove the exact before and proposed after values without substituting display text for authority.

automation.transition.compatibility_clea.text: No compatibility adaptation or refusal is required for this exact reconstruction.

automation.transition.compatibility.miss.text: Required generator hardware has no matching installed assembly address.

automation.transition.compatibility.unsu.text: A restored policy action is unavailable under the current contract capability envelope.
A restored policy condition is unavailable under the current contract capability envelope.

automation.transition.compatibility.inva.text: A generator or assembly address cannot be resolved exactly in the selected boundary.
A restored Route control does not belong to the Component that would command it.

automation.transition.compatibility.miss.text: The selected design requires typed opening material that the current assembly does not declare.

automation.transition.compatibility.regi.text: The declared opening assembly cannot be established under the active regime's physical limits.

automation.transition.compatibility.gene.text: Continuing would require changing generator bytes rather than reconstructing the selected design exactly.

automation.transition.refusal.wrong_run_.text: This reconstruction is available only inside an automation contract attempt.

automation.transition.refusal.wrong_life.text: Pause in Design or Commission before reconstructing. A running or executing Field cannot change authority.

automation.transition.refusal.stale_cont.text: The active contract identity changed after this preview was resolved.

automation.transition.refusal.stale_atte.text: The active attempt changed after this preview was resolved.

automation.transition.refusal.stale_bran.text: The active branch changed after this preview was resolved.

automation.transition.refusal.stale_gene.text: The committed generator changed after this preview was resolved.

automation.transition.refusal.stale_asse.text: The committed opening assembly changed after this preview was resolved.

automation.transition.refusal.stale_prev.text: The preview no longer matches fresh source authority. Resolve a new preview before confirming.

automation.transition.refusal.source_una.text: The exact immutable reconstruction source is unavailable. Display metadata and thumbnails cannot substitute for its canonical bytes.

automation.transition.refusal.source_cor.text: The selected source bytes do not reproduce their retained canonical identity and cannot drive reconstruction.

automation.transition.refusal.incompatib.text: The current declared assembly cannot establish the selected generator without an unreviewed design or assembly change.

automation.transition.refusal.reconstruc.text: Rust could not establish the previewed opening exactly. The current branch remains unchanged.

automation.transition.refusal.qualificat.text: This candidate is frozen for qualification. Return to an editable Commission or Design branch before reconstructing.

automation.transition.refusal.unsupporte.text: The requested reconstruction kind is not supported by this protocol version.

automation.operation_recovery.explanatio.text: Each assembly revision or reconstruction is journaled before publication. Reload retries only missing byte-identical records and pointer writes; it never repeats an accepted Rust mutation. Manual recovery means the child lacks enough durable authority to publish automatically.

automation.operation_recovery.status.pre.text: Prepared only; no Rust mutation accepted

automation.operation_recovery.status.man.text: Manual recovery required; do not repeat commit

automation.attempts.empty.text: No branch has closed in this contract. Restart, revise, return, or replace the candidate to retain its evidence.

automation.attempts.persistence_error.text: Durable browser storage is unavailable. This session retains the evidence in memory, but reloading may remove it.

automation.attempts.margin_unavailable.text: No provisional criterion margin was retained.

automation.comparison.direct_parent.text: Direct parent of the current branch

automation.comparison.no_observed_differ.text: No difference appears in the bounded addressed event windows.

automation.comparison.observed_only.text: This view aligns retained observations. It does not claim that a design difference caused an outcome difference; that requires a controlled paired trial.

automation.breakpoint.hit.text: Paused after retained event at step

automation.margin.provisional.text: These are live Commission readings. They identify weak service margins but do not constitute a qualification pass or retained unlock evidence.

contract.intake.brief.text: Program the mobile Component to detect local Supply, move into coupling range, acquire Charge, and keep the receiver above its declared floor for 180 hands-off steps.

contract.intake.success.text: The receiver retained service while the programmed Component acquired and delivered local Supply without direct control.

contract.intake.failure.text: Service fell below a declared criterion. Inspect the first affected Component, the selected rule, its target, and the action outcome.

contract.intake.guide.sense.text: Supply detection is local. A Supply condition is true only when the authored Current is inside the selected sensor radius and matches the requested emitting state.

contract.intake.guide.acquire.text: Seek Supply moves toward the deterministic nearest eligible Current. Coupling remains a separate action and succeeds only after the target is inside physical reach.

contract.intake.guide.deliver.text: Stored Charge and receiver Charge are separate readings. Acquisition alone does not satisfy the contract until accepted transfer keeps the addressed receiver above its floor.

contract.transfer.brief.text: Coordinate an owned interface and directed Route so requested flow becomes accepted flow and the receiver remains above its operating floor for 240 hands-off steps.

contract.transfer.success.text: The endpoint remained available, the required Route accepted flow, and the receiver sustained service without intervention.

contract.transfer.failure.text: The transfer path lost service. Inspect endpoint state, Route enablement, request, control limit, accepted flow, source stock, and destination headroom.

contract.transfer.guide.open.text: A physical Route does not imply an open endpoint. Set Interface changes the exact owned gate; it does not transfer Charge by itself.

contract.transfer.guide.route.text: An enabled Route may request flow, but accepted flow is still bounded by source stock, the committed control limit, physical capacity, and destination headroom.

contract.transfer.guide.sustain.text: Qualification uses the minimum accepted flow and minimum receiver Charge across the declared observation window, not a favorable final frame.

contract.buffer.brief.text: Build reserve while periodic Supply emits, then spend that finite stock across complete quiet intervals while every required transfer and receiver remains in service.

contract.buffer.success.text: The programmed machine accumulated reserve, bridged each input gap, restored stock, and sustained the complete 300-step hands-off interval.

contract.buffer.failure.text: A reserve, Route, receiver, or leakage criterion crossed its limit. Inspect the first violated window before changing thresholds or Route allocation.

contract.buffer.guide.fill.text: Emitting and quiet are authoritative Supply phases. Fill policy should react to the current phase and local reserve reading rather than elapsed wall time.

contract.buffer.guide.bridge.text: Average throughput can pass while one quiet interval fails. The minimum reserve and accepted-flow criteria remain active across the complete observation window.

contract.buffer.guide.recover.text: A stable cycle restores enough stock during emission to survive the next gap without starving required Routes or exceeding the leakage ceiling.

contract.ladder.description.text: Select a physical service requirement, inspect its exact limits and qualification criteria, then open its machine in Design.

contract.ladder.open_failed.text: The contract could not be opened. Its authored content or availability changed before the request was accepted.

contract.ladder.return_failed.text: The returned attempt could not open a new Commission branch. Its retained evidence remains unchanged.
